decisions.reason: The request for additional drawing file formats does not change the requirement to provide a complete drawing set.
Deliverable file formats do not alter the bushing geometry, fit, guidance, retention, or hole requirements.
The requested CAD and drawing formats do not change any main-shaft geometry attribute.
The file-format request does not change the sliding mandrel arrangement, holes, or required keyway groove.
Requesting DWG, DXF, IPT, and IDW deliverables does not change ČSN/EN compliance or mandate use of the available Inventor drawing template.
The requirement to deliver a 3D assembly model remains unchanged; its requested exchange and editable formats are independently represented by the source requirement.
The same message independently establishes drawing color treatment, but the deliverable-format modification does not change that presentation requirement.
The requested output formats do not change the fabrication or machining sequence.
Providing drawings in additional file formats does not alter the assembly-based numbering rule.
The file-format modification does not change specified materials or the requirement to show them on drawings.
The format request does not itself establish or change any dimension or annotation requirement; unspecified notes and minor corrections cannot be safely propagated.
The requested deliverable formats do not alter the specified 45-degree hole-axis orientation.
